research.2s38.2s38_hull_blueprint.desc: Tracked hull of the 2S38, carrying the engine, transmission and both track assemblies.
research.2s38.2s38_turret_blueprint.desc: Unmanned turret of the 2S38 with the 57mm 2A90 autocannon, a coaxial PKTM and two sights.
research.2s38.2s38_addon_armor_blueprint: Interchangeable skirt armor for the 2S38, four plates per side.
description.2s38.blueprint.2s38: Self-propelled anti-aircraft gun on a BMP-3 chassis with an unmanned, remotely operated turret. Its 57 mm 2A90 autocannon mixes armour-piercing and high-explosive rounds at roughly 120 rounds per minute. Passive electro-optical sights give an effective range of about 6 km against air targets and a ceiling of about 4.5 km; the gun also suppresses light armour on the ground. Combat weight is about 21.5 t and the vehicle remains amphibious.
